title: rattex KEYLESS
features:
RATTEX - FEATURE LIST

MAIN
- Auto Farm: collects coins using straight tween movement at 20 studs/second,
  with hovering and noclip.
- Farm Mode: Nearest, Nearest + XP Farm, or Randomize.
- Automatically Grab Gun: collects the dropped sheriff gun.
- Auto End Round: performs an action based on your current role.
- Teleport To Lobby.
- Teleport To Map.

TARGET
- Searchable player selection, excluding the local player.
- Fling Target: direct torso/head contact with high velocity and spin.
- Spectate Target.
- Loop Go To Target: continuously follows the selected player.
- Teleport To Target.
- Fling Sheriff: also recognizes the Hero/gun holder.
- Fling Murderer.

MISC
- Player Chams: outlines other players with no fill.
  Murderer: red. Sheriff/Hero: blue. Innocent: green. Lobby/no role: white.
- Gun Cham: blue outline on the dropped gun.
- 3DRendering: switches off 3D rendering when enabled.
- Name ESP: uses Roblox's built-in character name labels.
- Emote selection: ninja, dab, floss, headless, zen, zombie, sit.
- Auto Emote: plays while idle and blends between movement and emotes.

ROLES
- Kill Aura: knife attacks against nearby players when you are the murderer.
- Aura Distance: adjustable from 5 to 50 studs.
- Auto Kill All: repeatedly runs the knife attack against other living players.
- Silent Aim: redirects gun aim toward the living murderer with movement prediction.
- Kill Murderer (Blatant): equips the sheriff/Hero gun, locks 3.5 studs behind
  the murderer, enables Silent Aim and repeatedly shoots.
- Auto Shoot Murderer.
- Shoot Murderer: configurable keybind; C by default.
- Shooting keybind ignores typing in chat and other text boxes.

PLAYER
- Walk Speed: toggle and slider, 0 to 150.
- Jump Power: toggle and slider, 0 to 200.
- Anti Fling.

SETTINGS
- Auto Save Settings: saves settings to ShraksMM2/autosave.json in the
  executor workspace and loads them on the next execution.
- Auto ReExecute: queues the hosted loader for execution after teleporting.
- Auto Rejoin: is what it is.
- Rejoin Server.
- Server Hop: searches for another public server with space.
- Searchable command selection and Execute Command.
- Commands: kick yourself, sit, void, anchor, unanchor.
- UI Transparency.
- Show User Info.

COMING SOON...
- Dodge Thrown Knife.
- Invisible [FE].
- Webhook URL field.
- Coin Tracker.
- Minutes To Send Webhook field.
- Unbox Notification.
